title: Nourishing Norwegian Butternut Squash Casserole
description: A traditional Norwegian dish featuring fermented butternut squash, this casserole is kid-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is cooked in a scallop shell vessel for a unique presentation.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the cubed butternut squash and fermented buttermilk, and let it sit at room temperature for 2 hours to allow the squash to ferment slightly.
In a separate bowl, mix together the sour cream, shredded cheese, oats, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sour cream mixture to the bowl with the fermented squash, and stir until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into 6 scallop shell vessels, and dot the top of each with melted butter.
Place the scallop shells on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and bake for 30 minutes, or until the tops are golden brown.
Remove the casseroles from the oven, and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the casseroles hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
